verdict.rationale: First-party docs point to voice support: a Discord voice section, Discord voice transcripts and meeting notes, searchable meeting transcripts, and release notes saying you can "use GPT Live in meetings and calls", which implies live voice conversation. However, the evidence is only page titles and release-note headlines. Nothing describes how it works, what it is limited to, or whether voice notes on messaging channels like WhatsApp or Telegram are transcribed. missing for 10: documented voice-note transcription across messaging channels, spoken/TTS reply configuration, detailed docs on live voice call setup and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
